note: Every third-party asset the product loads at run time or ships in a package, including what npm audit cannot see (CDN scripts, WASM, OCR data, model weights). tests/suites/dependency-inventory.test.mjs fails when a pin in the code and its row here disagree, or when a row's advisory has no status.

assets.name: xlsx

advisories.what: prototype pollution when reading a crafted file
advisories.status: OPEN — upgrade blocked: the fixed releases are published only on cdn.sheetjs.com (npm stops at 0.18.5), and this environment's network policy refuses cdn.sheetjs.com and git.sheetjs.com (proxy 403, 2026-10-10)

advisories.what: ReDoS when reading a crafted file (CVSS 7.5)
advisories.status: OPEN — same block; target is the current 0.20.x from cdn.sheetjs.com, pinned by SRI hash in index.html and by sha256 in both offline builds

assets.mitigationsMeanwhile: imports are size- and row-limited and rejected whole when malformed (malformed-import); a parsed workbook's keys are checked for prototype pollution (hostile-input); a file over the parse size is announced before it blocks (import-scale). These do not replace the upgrade.

advisories.what: arbitrary JS via a crafted font when isEvalSupported is on
advisories.status: NOT AFFECTED — 5.7.284 is later; getDocument also passes isEvalSupported:false and the CSP has no eval

advisories.what: out-of-bounds read in ONNX shape inference on a crafted model
advisories.status: NOT REACHABLE — only the two pinned models below are ever loaded, each checked by sha256 before use
